title: Position Timestamp At Birth
description: A shipment's position is only ever as fresh as its last update — and the very first "update" is simply the moment it was booked.
successCondition: POST /api/booking to create a shipment and note the wall-clock time. Querying the shipments table via `npm run db:psql` confirms position_updated_at is NOT NULL and is within a few seconds of both created_at and the moment you made the request — the two timestamp columns are independently set but start off equal (or effectively equal) for a brand-new shipment.
hints: Both createdAt and positionUpdatedAt default to now() independently in prisma/schema.prisma — they aren't derived from each other, so verify both rather than assuming one implies the other.
select created_at, position_updated_at from shipments where id = '<id>'; puts both columns side by side.
